payload.body: The UI polish pass is done and human-accepted. Jim's six asks — rail gutter, three action buttons ending in 2x, 2x semantics, tray spacing, hand totals covering cards, triplicated card ranks — shipped as five PRs (#2 rail-gutter, #3 tray-rhythm, #4 card-face-declutter, #5 hand-total-placement, #6 double-wager-button) under epic tsg7x111, each Codex-reviewed and merged only on APPROVE. He tested extensively in the browser and approved on 2026-08-25. Two defects he had NOT reported were found and fixed in passing: the action cluster overflowed its grid track and hid Clear under a chip at every width, and the card centre pip was never centred (old grid areas put it in column two, x=62 on a 92px card). Suite went 69 -> 80 tests, 3484 -> 3538 asserts.
